description: Time freezes when trying to kick a villager out of a bed then breaking it i have attatched a video of the glitch and the log for that session it still loads chunks. Here is a video with the bug The game can also randomly freeze.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Place a bed on the ground.
3. Summon a villager near the bed using `/summon villager ~ ~ ~`.
4. Use the bed to kick the villager out of it.
5. Immediately break the bed after kicking the villager out.
6. Observe if the game freezes.
7. If the game does not freeze, repeat steps 4-6 several times to attempt to reproduce the bug.
8. Note any observations or take a screenshot when the freeze occurs.
Observed Behavior: The game can randomly freeze, particularly when attempting to kick a villager out of a bed and then breaking it. Time freezes during this interaction, causing the game to become unresponsive despite chunks continuing to load. This issue has been documented in a video attached with the bug report, showcasing the specific sequence of actions leading to the freeze. The associated log from that session further details the conditions under which the glitch occurs, providing developers with additional context for troubleshooting and resolution.
Expected Behavior: When attempting to kick a villager out of a bed and then breaking it, the game should not freeze. Time should continue normally, and the villager should be successfully kicked out of the bed. Afterward, the player should be able to break the bed without any issues, and the game should remain responsive and functional throughout these actions.
